differentiators.observation: Capacity contention is a one-mutation product fact: seats recomputed inside the serialized transaction made the two-actor final-seats race produce exactly one commit and an exact 12/12 booking with no counter service, no retry idiom, and no overbook window. The frozen Firebase arm needed a transaction-retry idiom and Supabase needed an RPC for the same fact.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Serialized commit order making naive read-check-write capacity logic correct, with the refusal settling the loser deterministically.

differentiators.observation: The image pipeline is real on the packaged closure and better than every frozen 0102 arm's raw-bytes story: strip-declared canonical bytes, declared card/thumb renditions served by key, typed media facts, strict per-request re-authorization with private/no-store headers, and deletion denying the next request — all proven externally. In the 0102 epoch Snapback's assets were a wholesale GAP.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: private-strict semantics (per-request re-auth, no-store, active-content never inline) and canonical-digest content identity.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: scenario-evidence.json A4-07 renditionIdentity/contentHash; diaries/0030 (Snapback arm asset GAP)

differentiators.observation: Session revocation is live at the asset boundary: a logged-out session's very next strict read is denied (401) after a 200 — per-request re-authorization needs no cache invalidation story. Frozen Firebase evidence documents up-to-an-hour token validity after revocation.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Every strict delivery re-authorizing through the current session state.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: scenario-evidence.json A4-08 authorityChange; diaries/0030 (Firebase revocation notes)

differentiators.observation: The public preview field boundary is a projection the server owns: the anonymous lane serves exactly the nine declared public fields and byte-level probes for the address, notes, codes, and guest identities all come back clean — while the same table's protected projections serve members. No RLS column juggling, no second table.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Handler-projected public queries with auth:'public' on a sessions server refusing offerless requests uniformly.

differentiators.observation: Invitation attribution is transactional: one mutation creates the seat, consumes the invite, and writes the attributed RSVP row (inviter, code, channel) with the settlement envelope carrying the receipt — the deep-link entry is a single atomic product fact instead of a client-orchestrated sequence.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: authority-creating membership self-insert + app-data writes composing in one serialized commit.

differentiators.observation: Ephemeral presence stayed genuinely ephemeral under an event-page load: both guests visible on the overlay lane while ten publishes advanced the durable store version by zero — the zero-durable-amplification property held on its third consecutive arm.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: The ephemeral overlay lane's TTL/rate-bounded collections never touching durable versions.
differentiators.referenceEvidence: scenario-evidence.json A4-06 transportAttribution; A2 capsule differentiators

differentiators.observation: The 11-check suite — fresh seed install, five personas + anonymous lane, a capacity race, live deliveries, two asset lifecycles, scheduler ticks, and two receipted resets — runs in 17.7s wall, and the deterministic tick + run-ledger receipts made the scheduler evidence collectable without ever sleeping on a cadence.
differentiators.mustNotRegress: Machine-readable dev lifecycle + admin tick seam + append-only run receipts.
